A.carrier_name: normalized triangular lattice axial boundary-edge carrier

euclidean_embedded_edge_length.derivation: Each frozen nearest-neighbor direction has Q=1, so sqrt(Q)=1.

native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.raw_quantity: A2 = sum_i det_Z(p_i,p_{i+1}) for the packet polyline closed by its endpoint chord
native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.raw_unit: one integer determinant-sum unit of A2

chord_length_unit.raw_endpoint_displacement: d=(Delta a,Delta b) in the rotated lattice's axial labels

euclidean_embedded_edge_length.derivation: Frozen boundary edges are original triangular-lattice nearest-neighbor edges; rigid R_phi preserves their Q=1 Euclidean length.

G.native_coordinate: axial Z^2 boundary vertices, embedded as v_phi(a,b)=R_phi*(a*e1+b*e2)

native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.axial_determinant_sum: S_axial=sum_i det_Z(p_i,p_{i+1}) after closing the packet by its endpoint chord
native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.common_protocol_requirement: For STAR operators use signed_area_E, not an unconverted legacy area field whose storage normalization is implementation-specific.
native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.conversion_to_ell_edge_squared: one axial determinant-sum unit = sqrt(3)/4 * ell_edge_G^2
native_shoelace_or_determinant_area_unit.euclidean_conversion: signed_area_E=(sqrt(3)/4)*S_axial, independent of lattice orientation phi

common_embedding_notation.euclidean_embedding: E(a,b)=a*e1+b*e2; G may additionally apply a rigid rotation R_phi

cross_arm_result.common_euclidean_area_conversion: Both arms can compute STAR signed area from frozen axial packet vertices as (sqrt(3)/4)*axial_determinant_sum.
cross_arm_result.important_boundary: Equality of the derived edge scale does not retroactively make frozen A SIGNED_BULGE_DENSITY and frozen G signed-area generator numerically identical; Stage C0 defines a new candidate basis.
